headline: European soccer leaders to boycott  the World Cup in an unprecedented step
context: In an unprecedented step, European soccer associations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes to the marquee soccer tournament.

sources.name: NPR
